cases.title: An ambiguous dispatch is never retried elsewhere
cases.when: The connection resets after DISPATCH is sent for a NON_IDEMPOTENT tool
then: The Gateway queries authorized Control metadata; a claimed or potentially consumed attempt is never blindly resent
A replacement permit requires complete positive never-consumed proof after permit expiry, fresh current authority and the original operation deadline; lack of a reply is not proof

cases.title: A host crash after ADMITTED ends OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
cases.when: The host process is killed after ADMITTED for a ledger tool, and for an idempotent tool
then: A consumed crash remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and is not automatically retried because of an idempotent label
A resolved business outcome requires all attempts and effects plus closed complete mediation or independent scope review

cases.title: A Gateway crash does not duplicate execution
cases.when: The Gateway crashes after dispatch; the client retries on another replica with the same key
then: One execution; the retry returns EXISTING or the task

cases.title: A client re-issue matches the existing invocation
cases.when: A client re-sends with a new JSON-RPC id and the same idempotency key, and within the dedupe window without a key
then: No second invocation for non-idempotent tools

cases.title: REFUSED cannot independently authorize another host
then: BUSY/refusal is reported evidence, not positive no-consumption proof
Retry elsewhere requires Control's complete never-consumed journal, current authority and the original deadline; it creates an independently retained fresh attempt

cases.title: Reconcile answers update OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
cases.when: A tool with @Reconcile ends OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; reconcile answers APPLIED, NOT_APPLIED and UNKNOWN in three runs
then: Outcome derivation preserves every attempt and effect; effectively-once claims require independent target commit evidence

NOT_APPLIED alone never grants re-execution; a fresh linked attempt on the same operation requires independently complete no-write proof or the separately approved safe-resend protocol, current authority and the original deadline

cases.title: Tools without reconcile are never re-executed
cases.when: A tool without the hook ends OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

cases.title: The broker records evidence for each request
cases.when: A ledger tool sends a request that times out
then: Route, status and upstream request id are recorded and attached to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

cases.title: The packager warns about retry libraries
cases.when: A NON_IDEMPOTENT tool configures a known retry library

cases.title: An unknown operation never authorizes blind retry
cases.when: A consumed worker reports an unknown effect and the caller repeats its request
then: Reservation is refused and submission returns the existing unknown invocation

cases.title: Qualified settlement closes authority without another attempt
cases.when: A qualified consumed attempt ends and settlement is requested repeatedly
then: Active settlement is refused; terminal settlement is idempotent, ends its matching lease and retains exactly one attempt

cases.title: Independent scope attestation never rewrites or reissues execution
cases.when: Distinct independent reviewers approve a revision-bound closed-attempt scope review, then repeat approval
then: Exactly one immutable proof applies; reported state and permit history remain unchanged
